column1: # Fantasi / LilyGO T-Embed (ESP32-S3) flash partition table.
# The T-Embed ships with a ~8 MB SPI flash (quad-SPI). Layout:
#   - littlefs: Fantasi storage region (256 KB) - LittleFS filesystem
# The 256 KB littlefs partition is the / (root) volume
# Fantasi's storage model on the other targets. `storage_flash_*` in
# the platform HAL reads/writes this region.
